articleTitle: Brain MRI Image Segmentation and Classification using PCA-SVM and CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Brain tumor is a malicious growth on surface of the brain or within the brain tissues, it is a life-threatening disease which can spread to other vital parts with slow pace, if not detected early it can cause various effects on your body. These abnormal growths can be identified from images on medical reports generated from Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI). Categorizing different kinds of brain tumors can be made easier by using machine learning and deep learning techniques. These techniques could prove advantageous in identifying the existence of a tumor during its early phases. In order to classify MRI images, this study uses Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Support Vector Machines (SVM) in conjunction with Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to extract features from brain MRI images. Additionally, image segmentation methods are incorporated like image thresholding, contour detection, edge detection and histogram equalization for better identification of tumor.

articleTitle: UAVC: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Communication Using a Coot Optimization-Based Energy Efficient Routing Protocol
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Because of their ability to be deployed in open environments with a high degree of flexibility and mobility, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) have garnered a considerable amount of attention in both military and civilian applications with the goals of enabling ubiquitous connectivity and fostering dynamic communications. The challenge is caused by aspects other than mobile ad hoc networks (MANET), specifically aerial mobility in three-dimensional space and frequently shifting topology. One and the same node in the UAV network is responsible for all three functions. The communication path is typically made up of multiple hops, and the routing decision has a substantial impact on how well the network performs. When choosing the most effective routing system, performance analysis should receive a significant amount of attention and effort. As a result of this impetus. The COAER-UAVC approach that has been given creates efficient communication pathways between the UAVs. To a large extent, it is predicated on the behaviors of Coot in their natural environments, such as fighting and hunting iguanas and evading predators. In addition, the COAER-UAVC technique that has been provided places an emphasis on the development of fitness functions with the goal of minimizing both energy consumption and communication delay. In order to show the optimum performance of the COAER-UAVC system, a diverse collection of simulations have to be carried out. The results of the experiments demonstrated that using the COAER-UAVC strategy resulted in significantly enhanced performance in comparison to using other methods.

articleTitle: Automatic Lung Disease Detection and Diagnosis Using Optimized Fuzzy Filter and Deep Learning Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Corona Virus Disease (COVID-19) is a life-threatening disease that was found in December of 2019 in Wuhan, China. A quick prediction can isolate infected people and prevent the disease from spreading to others. For some people, the Reverse Transcription Polymerase Chain Reaction (RT-PCR) test yields the negative result, but they may have an infection, so CT image prediction is the best solution for patients with symptoms. The primary goal of this research is to detect lungs infection quickly and automatically, as well as to improve COVID-19 prediction accuracy by improving image quality through image restoration and enhancement. The proposed research is divided into two modules: the first explains how to improve the quality of input lungs Computerized Tomography (CT) images using an optimized fuzzy filter, and the second explains how to predict and diagnose COVID-19 using DenseNet-121. The investigational results show that the proposed approach can accomplish 0.96 AUC score, 0.88 precision, 0.92 recall, 0.90 accuracy and 0.259 model loss. The proposed method outperforms previous works in CT images. Experimental results indicate that introducing an optimized fuzzy filter, which is used for image restoration and enhancement, improves prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Simulation, Deposition, and Characterization of WO3 and Multilayered WO3/Ag Thin Film Structure for Smart Window Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Tungsten oxide (WO3) and multilayered Tungsten oxide-silver (WO3/Ag) Thin layers were simulated and deposited for an electrochromic perspective of smart window applications. The simulation of the device was carried out to perform cyclic voltammetry analysis. Further, the thin films were experimentally deposited using DC Magnetron Sputtering on an FTO Glass substrate and were characterized using an optical profilometer for thickness determination, and Cyclic voltammetry for I-V relation analysis. The goal of this work is to carry out a comparative analysis of single-layer and multilayered-layer performance for electrochromic applications. On the application of potential from -0.7 V to 1 V and a scan rate of 10mV/s, the single layer produced a cathodic current of –6.8 mA whereas the multilayer could produce -7.36 mA, Hence It is found that both simulated and Experimental results show that the multilayered deposition of WO3/Ag provides improved current than the single layer.

articleTitle: An efficient vehicle to vehicle communication system using intelligent transportation system
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The general public has used a lot of vehicles in recent years. Due to this, huge number of accidents and traffic jams have occurred, more infrastructure and security are required. So, to get around this problem, a vehicle-to-vehicle intelligent transport system communication algorithm is proposed to control traffic jams, improve security, and data accuracy by using the CMS Domain Model and direct V2V communication. The proposed algorithm showed better performance as compared to conventional methods such as multi-access edge computing networks and dedicated short-range communications (DSRC) with respect to travel time estimation, travel time efficiency, average vehicle speed and speed improvement. The time travel efficiency, vehicle speed, and time estimation has improved by 0.23%, 0.42%, and 0.21%, respectively.

Author Keywords: multi-access edge computing networks (MAEC) and dedicated short-range communications (DSRC)

articleTitle: Design and Modelling of VGG-16 Architecture for Lung Tumor Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The most common type of cancer, lung cancer, continues to be the leading cause of cancer-related death in all age categories. To aid early detection, a variety of representational strategies for lung nodules have been put forth. However, these methods run into problems since the datasets are too small and not diverse enough. A method to increase the data set and visualize the representation of pneumonic nodules is needed to solve this problem. Forward and Backward GAN (F&BGAN), a unique data expansion method based on Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), is presented and demonstrated to produce outstanding clinical images. The Backward GAN(BGAN) algorithm is used to examine images, and the Forward GAN (FGAN) technique is used to create alternative images. The multi-scale VGG-16 network additionally provides a framework for successfully removing discriminative components from stacked layers. The Lung Image Database Consortium and Image Database Resource Initiative data set are used to evaluate the proposed method, which shows impressive sensitivity of 91 percent, specificity of 90 percent, and accuracy of 96 percent in the Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve (AUROC).

articleTitle: The Identification of Conflicting Determinations of Anomalies in Computer Network Behaviour: Cyber Security in Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: New problems and difficulties have arisen as a result of smart cities' greater reliance on various forms of urban technology. Data-driven technologies and computer networks are used in a broad range of applications and municipal infrastructures. Intrusion detection systems are always looking for evidence of malicious activity on computer networks. Binary classifiers are good tools for determining whether data should be considered normal or pathological. The removal of redundant and unimportant data may be accomplished via the use of feature selection and feature scaling. Nine of the twenty-four numerical characteristics included within the Kyoto 2006+ dataset are regarded as being crucial for the training of models. This linearization is accomplished via a hyperbolic tangent normalization. Different machine learning techniques with proven classification abilities were utilized in this study. While there was a little decline in accuracy overall (less than 0.1 percent), there was a significant reduction in the amount of time it took to analyze data. According to the findings, there is an undeniable advantage to using TH scaling in terms of processing time. It doesn't matter how accurate the classifiers are; there are still situations when their conclusions aren't the same. Based on the XOR process achieved on the results of two separate classifications, we develop a conflicting decision detector. These classifiers are a feedforward neural network, which is the quickest, and a weighted k-nearest neighbor model, which is the most accurate but also the slowest. The findings indicate that up to 6% of the various choices made may be identified.

articleTitle: WARM WOMB: A Wireless Real-time Monitoring System for Neonatal Care in Resource-Limited Settings
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: To ensure the well-being of preterm babies and help them adjust to the outside environment, a environment similar to a womb has to be provided. The neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) is designed specifically for monitoring and caring for the health conditions of premature babies. However, in rural areas, many hospitals lack NICU facilities, which means parents often have to travel to multi-specialty hospitals in case of emergencies. Unfortunately, the cost of NICU care in these hospitals is often prohibitively high. To address these challenges, we propose a solution called Wireless Artificial Real-time Monitoring WOMB (WARM WOMB). This innovative system aims to provide effective care for low-risk premature babies in abnormal conditions. It features a compact and cost-effective infant incubator that helps maintain the baby's temperature at levels similar to that of the mother's womb. Additionally, the WARM WOMB system incorporates advanced monitoring capabilities. The hardware of this proposed system has been tested under various conditions to analyze its functionality. By integrating temperature regulation, vital sign monitoring, weight tracking, and real-time video capturing, the proposed WARM WOMB design offers a comprehensive solution for neonatal care. Its primary focus is on addressing the specific needs of premature babies and enhancing their overall care.

articleTitle: Exploring Thermometer Code Addition and Subtraction in Quantum Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Quantum computing, a new technology, has the potential to alter a wide range of fields, from encryption and chemistry to optimisation. Among its fundamental operations, addition and subtraction of integers are the most important. This study looks into the fascinating world of quantum computation, focusing on the clever thermometer code method to addition and subtraction. We reveal the underlying workings of these operations using Qiskit, an open-source quantum computing platform, by analysing the algorithms and quantum circuits that fuel them. We uncover the performance complexities of these quantum processes by thorough research over a wide range of input conditions. The findings show the way forward in a world filled with quantum promise. Thermometer code arithmetic emerges as a potent weapon in the quantum toolbox, with the potential to transform the way we calculate. This report is more than simply a look into quantum possibilities; it's a call to action, urging researchers to push their boundaries and realise the full potential of this revolutionary technology.

articleTitle: IoT- Inventory Stock Management
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The phenomenon of information as well as communication technology has made life easier in every way. Internet use has rapidly increased over the past ten years, becoming ingrained in daily life as a result. A method known as “home administration utilizing the Internet of Things” (IOT) uses a computer or mobile device to control standard house features. automatically through the Internet from anywhere in the world. It does this by employing sensors that are connected to the Internet. An effective technique for managing the kitchen inventory is described in this study. Warehouse administration has undergone a revolution. The core elements of an IOT inventory system for warehouse administration are load cells, HX711 load cell amplifier modules, and Node MCU. The amount of inventory in a storage container can be calculated using load cells, sensors that detect weight. The output signal from the load cell is amplified by the HX711 load cell amplifier module, making it simpler for a microcontroller or computer to receive and process. A cheap, Wi-Fi-enabled microcontroller called the Node MCU can link to the internet and send data from load cells and HX711 modules to a central database or cloud-based platform. Using these components, an IOT inventory system can monitor actual levels of stock, automatic reordering of depleted goods and provide alerts when inventory levels fall below a certain threshold. This can help warehouse managers optimize their inventory levels, reduce waste, and improve overall efficiency.

articleTitle: Virtual Reality in Human Resource Management: Past, Present and Future Trends
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive bibliometric analysis of 416 research articles from 1993 to 2023, specifically focusing on applying Virtual Reality in Human Resource Management. The study delves into publishing trends, prominent journals, and noteworthy contributors, including authors, institutions, and countries. The findings offer valuable insights for researchers, aiding in selecting reputable journals for publication and highlighting key research topics and emerging subfields. Future research should explore integrating VR with emerging technologies like artificial intelligence and data analytics to develop sophisticated HR solutions while also investigating the ethical implications of VR in recruiting and employee training to ensure fairness and transparency. Additionally, exploring how VR can enhance diversity and inclusion in hiring procedures by promoting empathy and unbiased decision-making is a promising area for further study.

articleTitle: Image to Audio Captioning for the Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Image captioning, as a research topic has been on a commendable rise due to its potential applications in the field of computer vision, with significant applications such as social media, e-commerce, and education. The proposed system presents an innovative advancement in image captioning which caters to visually impaired users. We propose a system with a self-attention and transformer mechanism along with an encoder-decoder-based architecture specifically designed for visually impaired people. The system uses a custom CNN for visual feature extraction from the input image, while an RNN acts as a natural language model to generate highly descriptive and informative captions. The attention mechanism is an image processing technique that breaks down parts of the image and decodes them sequentially, thereby enabling the system to manipulate pixel representations to facilitate better caption generation. This aim is to help visually impaired people to better understand and interact with visual information and aesthetics and to promote a greater sense of inclusivity and diversity in society.

articleTitle: DTMF-Based Digitally Controlled Home Automation: Hardware Experimentation and Implementation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The main objective of developing a digitally controlled home automation hardware project is to enable remote control of home appliances through a reliable and functional physical device. The project methodology utilizes the DTMF (Dual Tone Multi-Frequency) system, which eliminates the limitations of conventional wall switches that require physical proximity for operation. The DTMF allows users to control their utilizations by dialing a selected number for a specific load. The system employs a De-Multiplexer, flip-flop IC, and DTMF Decoder to receive commands from the mobile phone and produce a digital output that initiates the electrical relay driver to switch ON/OFF the load utilizations. This technology enables users to send commands to control home appliances using a phone, without requiring a microcontroller. The user must make a call and the system can receive commands from a mobile phone to operate the home appliances. The project uses bulbs to demonstrate the operation of AC loads, and is poweredby a 12V transformer.

articleTitle: Real-Time Parking Monitoring and Automatic Billing System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Traffic congestion is greatly exacerbated by the daily increase in automobiles. IoT is a vast field where several sensors are linked together over the internet using some form of data-sharing protocol. Finding and allocating closer parking is the major goal of this parking system. Via the internet of things, billions of elements can connect with numerous applications at anytime, anywhere. One of the daily responsibilities for people in any nation is looking for a free parking space. The time spent by the people looking for the parking lot is really significant time. The major goal of this study is to create a system that will enable users to get real-time communication about the availability of parking places close to them wherever they are. We used a variety of sensors in our system, including servo motors, RFID, liquid crystal displays, and infrared sensors. It can decrease the amount of time spent looking, the amount of fuel used and the amount of pollutants by creating this method. The slot availability is determined using an Infrared sensor. The Liquid Crystal Display will show if the slot is open or not. By using Internet of Things technology, the user will receive a notification with information about the available slots.

articleTitle: Textile Horizontal T-Shaped Ultrawide Band Microstrip Patch Antenna for WBAN Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: In the medical atmosphere wireless body area network technology plays a most common and difficult task for continuous health monitoring. The proposed design’s major goal is to accomplish a low Specific Absorption Rate (SAR) and to get excellent communication in a wireless sensor environment. An antenna is the most common communication equipment in the digital era with its unique designs and excellent findings. The design approach is appropriate to create a new horizontal T-shape slot in a rectangular patch UWB microstrip patch antenna used in medical environments for wearable applications and the designed antenna is simulated using a High-Frequency Structural Simulator (HFSS) utilizing a textile material, denim substrate. The designed antenna resonates at 7.7GHz with an acceptable gain of 4dB. The radiation pattern was measured using an anechoic chamber and the antenna gives a good return loss, better bandwidth, VSWR of 1.05, and the SAR value of the UWB antenna is below 2W. The result shows that the proposed design satisfies the requirements of a textile antenna used as a wearable for monitoring human health continuously in body area networks, technical and military applications.

articleTitle: A Survey on Synthesis and Analysis of EMG Signal
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: EMG Electromyography signals are biomedical signals that measures the electrical current generate during muscular contraction-relaxation represents neuromuscular activities and EMG signals are used for biomedical or clinical applications. The EMG signals also have its application in modern human-computer interaction and Evolvable Hardware (EWH) chip development. EMG signals are detected, decomposed processed and classified after acquired from the muscles, for the purpose of study or to investigate. The efficient and effective analysis and classification of the EMG signal is the main objective of the paper. This paper also includes understanding the EMG signals, its nature and to develop various algorithms and methodologies to study the EMG signal. It also includes hardware implementation by acquiring muscles potential during contraction-relaxation and to develop prosthetic hand control, human computer interface and grasp recognition. The comparative study is also made on acquiring EMG signals with various methods, analysis, decomposition, processing and classification is made. This paper gives information about understanding EMG signals and to develop powerful, cost effective, flexible, and weightless with effective application.

articleTitle: Intelligent Recognition of Leaf Abnormalities Using Deep Learning Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) have significantly improved the detection of different diseases affecting plants. The impact of unidentified and untreated plant diseases is to reduce crop yield significantly, as they negatively affect the quality and quantity of horticultural and agricultural products. Therefore, early recognition of plant diseases is essential for improving crop quality and reducing production losses. To this end, a modern framework has been developed that incorporates image acquisition and analysis, utilizing DNN models to calculate various evaluation metrics such as Recall, F1 scaling, accuracy, and precision. By diversifying the results, it becomes possible to differentiate between healthy and bacterial plant leaves. The proposed methodology has been tested on two types of plants - pepper, and potato - and can determine the percentage of infection on plant leaves.

articleTitle: Enhancing Face Detection and Recognition through Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Face recognition is a rapidly growing field with multiple applications. Numerous face recognition algorithms have been developed over the years. In this research, use a Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) based face detector for precise face detection, which surpasses other machine learning techniques, such as Haar Cascade. The suggested approach uses HOG for feature extraction and Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE), two generally used pre-processing methods, throughout the recognition process. The test picture and the training images are both used to extract HOG features. Lastly, this system employs Support Vector Machine (SVM) for classification, as it effectively classifies the HOG features. Pre-processing techniques are utilized to equalize illumination, reduce noise, and enhance contrast. The study's findings show the dependability and effectiveness of this approach in achieving superior face recognition performance.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Personalized Nutrition using F-AHP, Fuzzy TOPSIS and Multicriteria Selection Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: An individually tailored dietary plan is a personalized nutritional strategy developed to cater to the specific needs, goals, and health circumstances of each individual. In conducting this research, we have employed two sophisticated techniques of fuzzy logic TOPSIS and AHP to evaluate the criteria for recommending dietary plans. These include age, body mass index (BMI), dietary preference (vegan/vegetarian/non-vegetarian), lifestyle, and blood sugar level, constituting five important factors for analysis. This method was chosen due to its uncomplicated nature and ability to handle linguistic variables through triangular membership functions. The decision-making participants involved in this process include dieticians and medical professionals. By utilizing these approaches, we are able to get the weights of the criterion also ranking various alternatives, such as a well-balanced diet, low-carbohydrate diet, and a diabetes-specific diet

articleTitle: Three-Phase Cascade H-bridge Inverters: A Comparative Study of GOA and FGOA for Selective Harmonic Elimination
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: This paper presents the use of improved Grasshopper optimization Algorithm (GOA) known as the Faster Grasshopper optimization Algorithm (FGOA), that is based on nature-inspired optimization algorithms for calculating the optimal switching angle to apply a 3-phase, cascaded H-bridge multilevel inverter. The optimized switching angles are calculated based on the best cost function formulated using the concept of the SHEPWM method to achieve an optimized output voltage with the desired fundamental voltage and minimize the low-order harmonics in the output produced by the multilevel inverter. The programmed simulation results show that the algorithm produces optimal switching angles for different modulation indexes than traditional techniques like the Newton-Raphson method and also gives a lower cost function comparable to GOA. MATLAB/SIMULINK performed on a three-phase, 5-level, 7-level and 9-level Cascaded H-bridge multilevel inverter are used to produced the staircase output waveform with the desired fundamental voltage and minimized lower-order harmonics using FGOA-derived optimal switching angles. The simulation studies and the model developed results are compared to showcase the FGOA-optimized SHEPWM outperforms comparable GOA in terms of convergence time, Fitness function, and THD.

articleTitle: CI/CD Pipeline with Vulnerability Mitigation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Our research focuses on enhancing the CI/CD pipeline with innovative approaches for vulnerability mitigation and effective handling of dependency-based attacks. By integrating advanced security measures throughout the development stages, we identify and address vulnerabilities early on. Through rigorous monitoring and strict control of dependencies, we ensure robust protection against potential attacks. The positive outcome of our research is a fortified CI/CD pipeline that streamlines software development, reduces security risks, and enables rapid and secure software deployments, thereby enhancing overall software reliability and trust.

articleTitle: Intelligent Crop Selection for Maximizing Agricultural Productivity: A Fuzzy TOPSIS Perspective
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: In the realm of modern agriculture, the judicious selection of crops plays a pivotal role in achieving higher yields and sustainable farming practices. This paper presents a comprehensive study employing the Fuzzy Technique for Order of Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS) to facilitate the intelligent selection of crops tailored to specific environmental conditions. The study considers four distinct criteria and evaluates four alternative crops, providing a structured approach to prioritize and recommend the most suitable crops for cultivation. The results of this research hold significant promise for farmers seeking guidance on crop selection, enabling them to make informed decisions regarding the optimal crop choices for their individual parcels of land. By harnessing the power of fuzzy TOPSIS methodology, this study contributes to the enhancement of agricultural productivity and empowers farmers to make choices that can positively impact their yields and economic returns.

articleTitle: Investigating the Impact of Dataset Size on Model Complexity for Leaf Disease Recognition using CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Detecting plant diseases poses a formidable challenge in agriculture, impacting crop yield and environmental sustainability. Timely and accurate disease prediction can enhance crop production and market value while minimizing ecological harm. The effectiveness of Deep learning models in recognizing plant leaf diseases depends on the quality and quantity of the training data and the model's architecture. Large Datasets present significant challenges regarding memory requirements, Computation, and storage. This can be solved by developing Deep Learning models that perform well with limited training data. This work comprehensively explores approaches for developing efficient deep learning models that can perform well with limited training data. The work considers two scenarios to test the system's performance: limited data with a comparatively complex CNN model and comparatively larger data with a simple model; both are good at accuracy, but deployment model design plays a role. Thus the proposed algorithm can help the model converge more efficiently, making the most of the available data and potentially mitigating the impact of data scarcity.

articleTitle: Sustainable Energy Efficient Routing Protocol using Chimp algorithm and SOM for Underwater Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Underwater Wireless Sensor Networks (UWSNs) are increasingly being used for various applications, such as environmental monitoring, underwater exploration, and oceanographic research. protocols that consume less energy for underwater wireless sensor networks (UWSNs) are still a difficult undertaking because of the harsh conditions present underwater and the restricted battery capacity of the sensor nodes. This research paper proposes an optimized multi-Hop routing protocol using Chimp Optimization and Self-Organizing Map (SOM). The proposed technique is compared with three popular routing protocols - AODV, DSDV, and DSR in terms of network lifetime and packet delivery ratio. Chimp Optimization algorithm as well as SOM are used to improve network performance. The findings indicate that the put-forward technique exceeds the performance of existing routing protocols, as it increases network lifetime, PDR and PLR while decreasing packet loss ratio. The network lifetime of the put-forward technique is 1039.42 seconds, which is higher than AODV, DSDV, and DSR. Similarly, the PDR of the proposed technique is 97.38%, which is comparatively higher than the three routing protocols. Moreover, the PLR of the proposed technique is 2.62%, which is much lower than AODV, DSDV, and DSR. The proposed technique based on Chimp Optimization and SOM can effectively optimize the multi-Hop routing protocol in underwater wireless sensor networks to achieve sustainable energy efficiency, thus providing important insights for researchers and practitioners to enhance the performance of underwater wireless sensor networks.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Crime Pattern Recognition: A Study of Crime Hot Spots and High-Risk Areas
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Crime is a global problem that affects individuals, communities, and societies at large. There are many different types of crime, and the rates at which they occur vary widely from country to country. While the need to be able to detect crime as it is happening is a very important part of safety and security, systems that can predict and analyze crimes are just as vital to a safer world. Understanding crime patterns and trends is crucial for effectively addressing the issue. One way to gain insights into crime is through the use of crime data analysis systems. These systems can help law enforcement agencies, policymakers, and researchers to identify patterns and trends in crime, as well as evaluate the effectiveness of different crime-prevention strategies. In our research we used four distinguished approaches: eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), CatBoost, Tabnet, and a hybrid model 1 Dimensional Convolution Neural Network through three individual datasets to compare the results of each approach as well as a comparison between the three datasets. Our results demonstrated a very significant advantage of utilizing feature oriented datasets over a large sample size such as the Chicago dataset. We observed XGBoost provides the best results for Chicago and San Francisco 96.51% and 26.50% respectively. And as for Boston, we obtained best accuracy (20.80%) using the Bagging classifier.

articleTitle: Automated Water Monitoring and Regulation System using Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Monitoring the quality of water in real-time is crucial for ensuring the safety and cleanliness of water, given its vital importance in our daily lives. Most water filtration systems both manual and high end have the technology to filter the instream water supply into a pre-programmed or manually fixed level of filtration level during the time of its installation. This fixation of water filtration level is solely based on the salinity and other qualities of the instream water supply in the system. Therefore, the only option if the characteristics of the instream water supply change is to manually reprogram the system to maintain the previous/desired filtration level. The proposed project includes hardware and software to enable the existing water purifier with the Internet of Things. pH value, Electrical Conductivity, and Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) value are some of the few aspects that are used to determine the quality of water. The technology that will be used in the project is the Internet of Things (IoT), which is an advanced and efficient solution for connecting devices like electronic gadgets, sensors, etc. to the Internet. The system monitors the water properties like TDS value, pH value, hardness, and electrical conductivity before sending it to the purifier. The collected data from sensors will be sent to the user using IoT. Based on the data and threshold value of the water quality the user will decide whether to purify the water or is it fit for consumption. The data updated from the implemented system can be accessed using IoT from anywhere at any time.

articleTitle: Streamlining Drone Battery Charging: The Power of Wireless Transmission and Embedded Automation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: This project introduces a non-radiative wireless power transmission method for charging the batteries of drones, specifically unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). It involves the development of an advanced drone battery charging system consisting of a charging station equipped with wireless power transmitters and a receiver for drone battery charging. The system utilizes a resonance inductive coupling-based wireless power transmission technique. While the efficiency of power transmission in inductive coupling is reliant on a strong coupling between the transmitter and receiver, drones often struggle to land accurately on charging stations or devices to achieve maximum coupling for efficient wireless power transfer. To align the transmitter and the receiver for the coupling without loss, infrared sensors and the ultrasonic sensors are used and the power is transmitted. However, the proposed system is a novel approach based on the hill Embedded Automation system to regulate the coupling without the need for physical sensors.

articleTitle: Cloud Based Online Bus Ticket System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The current system for booking bus tickets is reliant on humans and can be cumbersome. This project aims to develop a web application that simplifies the ticket booking process, allowing students, employees, and anyone else to easily book bus tickets. Unlike existing applications that only provide information on travel destinations and fares, the application not only facilitates ticket booking but also stores the tickets in a secure cloud database. Users can purchase tickets using their smartphones or laptops through the web application, eliminating the need to carry physical railway tickets. The ticketing information is securely stored in the cloud database, and a ticket checker application is provided to authenticate user tickets. The ticket checker can search for a user’s ticket in the cloud database using the ticket number or relevant information for verification purposes. In case a user’s display is damaged or there are issues like battery failure preventing the display of the ticket, there was an alternative safeguard option. The ticket can be validated by searching the ticket database using the ticket number or other relevant user information.

articleTitle: Modern WSN Routing Protocol using Methods for Reducing Energy Consumption based on Block Chain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The wireless sensor network (WSN) may be susceptible to a number of dangerous hacks, so they mostly rely on the authentication and encryption technique to get over this issue. Due to the real-time modification of routing information, the most common routing techniques in literature are fallbacks in describing the malicious nodes on networks. In this work, a block chain-based authentication method for wireless sensor networks safe routing is provided (WSNs). It is challenging to accurately determine the routing path because hostile and unauthenticated nodes interfere with the routing process. The wireless sensor network (WSN) may be susceptible to a number of dangerous hacks, so they mostly rely on the authentication and encryption technique to get over this issue. The Base Station (BS) performs a mutual authentication and authenticates each node involved in the routing process. Additionally, the Cluster Head (CH) selects the forwarder CH node in the suggested routing protocol depends on the least range and remaining energy from the BS before forwarding the data. According to the simulation results, suggested model increases both the network lifetime and t the amount of packets delivered.

articleTitle: Customer Segmentation Based on E-Commerce using K-Mean Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Due to the increasing growth of customers in market, there is fierce competition in business. Relationships between businesses and customer will be strengthened by understanding customer needs. The importance of giving users a comprehensive experience increases as a result of the digital market's rapid growth. The dataset from an ecommerce website is used in this study to identify all the factors for analysis, including date, customer id, and product; with the help of k-Mean clustering and decision tree. This research work will determine the most effective technique for Customer Segmentation. This facilitates the identification and resolution of distinct requirements and preferences among diverse customer segments. Customer Segmentation is a multifaceted strategy that can positively impact various aspects businesses, from revenue and profitability to customer satisfaction and long-term growth.

articleTitle: Investigation and Validation of Non Invasive Blood Glucose Measurement
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Diabetes is a metabolic disease that affects people who are unable to keep blood glucose levels within the range of 90–140 mg/dL. Potential causes of diabetes include a shortage of blood cells or blood cells that are insulin-resistant. According to a 2016 poll, 415 million people across the globe currently possess diabetes, and will be twice by 2035. In India, currently 77 million people possess diabetes, and by 2045, it is expected to be over 134 million. Monitoring of blood sugar levels at regular period will help to prevent diabetes-related issues. The majority of glucose testing tools on the market today are invasive, uncomfortable, expensive, and have a short lifespan. In this work, a non-invasive system is proposed to measure the blood glucose level using Galvanic Skin Response (GSR) and various physical parameters like temperature, heart rate, and blood pressure. The system achieves 95% accuracy with maximum of 10% error for the measurement rage between 60 to 100 mg/dl.

articleTitle: Digital System Design of ALU using Reversible Logic Gates
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: In the integrated circuit designs, the Area, Power dissipation and Time delay will play an important role. The Speed will rises with decreasing the size of a computing element and mean while heat dissipation will lowers with decreasing power dissipation. Future technologies for quantum computing will involve reversible logic, and reversible logic gates reduce leakage power usage. Reversible logic gates were used to design the arithmetic and logical unit (ALU) in this research work. Electronic unit such as ALU’s are built upon conventional or irreversible logic gates. Due to the saturation of Moore’s law, alternating ways are formed where new semiconductor materials and new methodologies have been implemented. One such way is to use reversible logic gates instead of irreversible logic gates. In this application of VLSI design, reversible logic has significantly emerged in power optimization technology. To validate functionality, each suggested design was analyzed and simulated using cadence virtuoso.

articleTitle: An Efficient Electronic Nasal Pod for Air Pollutants Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: This work focus to develop an Efficient device for the detection of air pollutants which is cost-effective, user friendly and wearable device. This device mainly works with the sensors and it performs with various aspects in terms of temperature, pulse rate monitoring and also it detect the amount of pollution by using Air Quality Sensor. The ranges of pollutants that are present in our area/cities can be detected easily. In this method we are going to imbed the nasal air filter (NAF) along with sensors. The prototype is designed by using two applications that is embedded C and Arduino programming. The proposed system comprises of an Arduino based microcontroller, a MQ 3 sensors for volatile organic compound (VOC) measurement, and a Wi-Fi module for application connection with internet. The device is tested with usage case in the surrounding places and also, the use of Smartphone compatibility for data storing is presented. This paper presents a microcontroller-based electronic nasal pod which majorly includes the following stages for detecting the air quality, monitors heath status, and displays the results along with person states. The work also gives the location of the device by using Zigbee module and hence user exact location can be traced.

articleTitle: Advanced Features for Electric Vehicle: The Future Smart Transportation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Over the last decade, in all developing countries Electric Vehicles (EV) stand attractive as more common mode of transport in all filed of the transportation sector. The EVs can cause significant impacts on the environment, and power systems, and are likely to replace internal combustion engine vehicles in the coming years. In India the recent cases of electric vehicle catching fire have raised safety concerns. Also, throughout the world the percentage of vehicle theft has become very substantial, and the condition is even worse in developing nations. Therefore, there is need for an intelligent, reliable, effective, and economical system for the protection of vehicles. Hence, in this paper, a novel method is adopted which protects the EV by developing advanced features such as detecting fire, temperature, and EV accidents and providing alertness to the owner instantly through messages. Also, advanced Anti-Theft vehicle security feature has been designed and executed employing a sensor-network system technology to track the EV. The proposed tracking system combines technology features of Global System for mobile communication (GSM) and Global Positioning System (GPS) and capable to secure, monitor and track the EV within a short time.

articleTitle: Unstructured Healthcare Statistics Exploration Consuming Modest Ensemble Machine Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Various approaches to classifying emotions can be found inside an ML study. Of course, there are ML algorithms that do exceptionally well on particular text datasets but underwhelm on other, larger datasets. To get over this issue, several classifiers should be combined to boost classification performance across all datasets. In order to select the most effective classifiers for use in an ensemble, this study presents a competitive ensemble classification technique. The effectiveness of sentiment classification should improve as a result of this. Unstructured healthcare data is discussed together with the proposed competitive ensemble classification algorithm. This method employs Twitter data extraction to do multiclass sentiment categorization. They have been categorised into one of five mood groups. In this study, we propose a model that uses a competition between several types of classifiers to determine which ones will work best for ensemble learning. To enhance classification performance, weights are assigned to five separate classifiers, and both the suggested model and a benchmark are assessed. The proposed approach, based on empirical evidence, outperforms baseline categorization methods. To evaluate the effectiveness of the work proposed, experimental results are compared to standard datasets. The outcomes show that the proposed model is superior, with an increase in classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Social Media Marketing with Social Pilot and NodeJS Optimization Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: This web technology is designed based on techniques such as Node.js, REST API, and AWS services. We developed a backend web application that retrieves the latest tweets based on a given hashtag, following the Route-Middleware-Controller approach to writing clean code. We researched Meta and Twitter documentation to find the updated limits for alternate text for images through the API and updated the SocialPilot Node.js code accordingly. We also gained experience with Git and Gitlab and learned about JEST unit testing, fixing over 150 test cases, and writing over 200 new ones for the POST functionality of the SocialPilot tool. We then focused on optimizing the flow of the schedule PDF functionality. We achieved it by refactoring and optimizing the code, eliminating the need for Redis and one less S3 bucket storage, as the PDF generation was migrated to React.js from Pug.js. This work helped me gain experience with AWS Lambda, SQS, S3, and Redis storage. Finally, we worked on the merge PDF functionality, allowing users to create reports for analytics of multiple social media accounts and download the merged PDFs. We created APIs for creating and updating reports and managing the schedule of merged PDFs. This paper covers various skills and technologies regarding different optimization techniques for managing the social media platform.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Techniques for Classification and Prediction of Structures and Rocks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Knowledge of the rocks, concrete, or constructions is often necessary. Mineshaft operations, salvage efforts, and tunneling are a few examples of such analyses. The real time analysis of the rocks and structures is one of the research areas where there are much things to explore and problems to solve. I propose a solution for the problem of real-time evaluation of the rocks and buildings based on machine learning algorithm. The structure and other properties of the stones, concretes, etc.…. are captured using sophisticated cameras and sensors. Support Vector Machine (SVM) is one of the most incredible AI procedures for performing grouping. Support Vector Network with outlier filters find and spots the outliers before the classification process. The proposed process classifies and predicts the type of rock under study with correctness precision of 85% in comparison with real characteristics of the rock.

articleTitle: Hand Gestures and Machine Learning: A Novel Path to Number Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The gesture-based communication system proves highly valuable for individuals who are almost deaf and discourse disabled. It allows them to convey messages effectively through gestures. The objective of this application is to provide a platform that accurately interprets these signs, enabling regular individuals to understand the gestures. The system detects and recognizes the gestures and displays the corresponding characters. This technology, which utilizes the PCA method, achieves comparable accuracy to other existing systems and methods. The system we have developed plays a crucial role in enabling individuals to understand and communicate like normal people using static gestures. While various proposals exist for gesture systems with specific languages like ASL, ISL, etc., we introduce a new set of static gestures using MATLAB, building upon existing systems. The system involves capturing input through a camera, after which the system applies preprocessing techniques to enhance the captured image. Next, a set of features is extracted from the preprocessed image using PCA (Principal Component Analysis). To identify the gestures, the system compares these features with those in the training sets, using the Euclidean Distance method. Our hand gesture system has been designed to recognize and interpret numbers from 0 to 5. Once a gesture is identified, the system can produce the output in the form of text ensuring effective communication for the users.

articleTitle: Unveiling Hidden Ties: Exploring Community Structures in Social Networks using Advanced Graph Analytics
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: In an era characterized by ubiquitous online social interactions, understanding the intricate structures and hidden connections within social networks is paramount. This research embarks on a journey to uncover concealed ties and explore the captivating world of community structures in social networks, leveraging the power of advanced graph analytics. The primary purpose is to reveal the latent bonds and relationships that often lie beneath the surface of seemingly unstructured social networks. By doing so, this study seeks to shed light on how users organize themselves into communities based on shared interests, affiliations, or patterns of interaction. This exploration aims to deepen comprehension of the underlying dynamics that shape digital societies. To achieve this, advanced graph analytics techniques, including modularity optimization and community detection algorithms, are employed. Social network data is analyzed to identify clusters of users with strong intra-cluster connections and limited inter-cluster links. Bridging users, pivotal in connecting disparate communities, are also unveiled through this methodology. These techniques allow for the revelation of community structures and the quantification of their quality through modularity scores. This research uncovers the presence of distinct and meaningful communities within diverse social networks. These communities are marked by shared interests and distinct network behaviors. Furthermore, the study identifies and analyzes bridging users, pivotal figures who facilitate interactions between otherwise disconnected communities. The modularity scores obtained underscore the effectiveness of this approach in emphasizing community cohesion.

articleTitle: Design and Characterization of a Gold Nanoparticle-based Plasmonic Biosensor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Nanotechnology has transformed biosensing, making it more powerful and precise. By using tiny materials like nanoparticles (NPs) and nanowires, biosensors can detect biological molecules with incredible accuracy. These nanoscale structures have large surface areas, which helps them capture and interact with target substances effectively. As a result, biosensors equipped with nanotechnology can provide faster, more accurate, and portable detection capabilities, benefitting fields such as healthcare, diagnostics, and environmental monitoring. Furthermore, nanotechnology-enabled biosensors offer improved sensitivity. The unique properties of nanomaterials, such as their high surface-to-volume ratio and tunable surface chemistry, enable precise control over the sensor’s performance and selectivity. In this paper, FDTD software is used to construct and simulate Gold nano-dimers. By adjusting the diameter of a gold(Au) NP, the opportunistic properties of Au NP, such as strong extinction and Localized surface plasmon resonance (LSPR), are examined, altering the surrounding medium’s refractive index. Two NPs are coupled after studying the properties of single NP. Variations in the radius and the distance between the two NPs are made in order to analyse the surface enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) and the extinction cross spectrum. Furthermore, a texured substrate is designed. The results obtained from the textured surface to the plain one are compared. The results proves that the textured surface is better suited for biological sensing applications.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approach to Predict ADHD Types using EEG Signal Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Early diagnosis and treatment of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) in children is essential for their overall wellbeing. A recent study introduced a method to classify ADHD as types. Machine Learning (ML) algorithms have revolutionized medical field, offering unprecedented potential in the diagnosis and categorization of complex conditions like ADHD and its subtypes. The proposed approach utilized supervised machine learning, specifically the K-Nearest Neighbour, Decision Tree and Random Forest using Conners data as input variables. EEG (Electroencephalography) signal data was employed to identify the specific type of ADHD. The proposed work introduces machine learning algorithms designed for ADHD classification, assessed using various statistical parameters including recall, precision, accuracy, and F1-score. Using Conners data, the results showed a 79.51% categorization accuracy. This outcome strongly underscores the significance of Conners data in effectively categorizing ADHD, highlighting its pivotal role in the process.

articleTitle: Fast and Accurate Prediction of Diabetes Mellitus using Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Diabetes mellitus, also commonly known as diabetes, is a disease that is spreading rapidly across the world. It is a major metabolic disorder in which the human body is unable to manage its blood glucose levels. Insulin is a hormone secreted by the pancreas that helps convert blood glucose into useful energy for the body. In diabetes, the human body does not produce enough or sufficient insulin and is not able to utilize the insulin it produces properly. This excessive glucose level in the blood causes serious health problems like blindness, heart attack, renal disease, kidney problems, etc., and it leads to death. Patients need to pay a lot of attention to the disease because there is no cure for it and it can be controlled by regular check-ups and medicine. It is necessary to control the growth of diabetes through early detection. So, we are proposing a quick and intelligent system based on an artificial neural network that can help with early detection of diabetes and be helpful to the doctor for early treatment so it can stop the progression of the disease. In this research work, a dataset from Pima, India, was used to predict the possibility of diabetes. The proposed artificial neural network model has an accuracy of 96.35%.

articleTitle: Optimal Location of Series Capacitor for Reducing Transmission Losses and Improving Economy of Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Increasing demand of electricity usage made power system engineers to think about increasing generation. But increasing generation comes at huge capital cost, as site required for erecting a power plant is huge. Also, conventional power plants must be situated far away from load centers, this poses stress on existing transmission networks Existing transmission network are old and have poor efficiency. Poor efficiency of transmission network leads to increased losses and reduced economy of the overall system. Transmission losses can be reduced by different methods, one of the simple methods is by reducing the impedance of the transmission line. Impedance of transmission line can be reduced by inserting series capacitor. This paper presents an approach to identify optimal location of series capacitor in a transmission line to reduce transmission losses and to improve overall economy of the power system. The proposed method is tested on IEEE 5-bus system.

articleTitle: Development of GUI for Acquiring and Monitoring Tip Clearance
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Gas turbines are an essential component in the energy and aviation industries, providing reliable and efficient power generation and propulsion. A gas turbine is a form of turbine that employs compressed gas to rotate and produce electrical power or provide propulsion to an aircraft or jet. Tip clearance is one of the key factors in gas turbine architecture, referring to the distance between the tip of the blade and the outer casing in a gas turbine engine. It significantly affects the efficiency of the gas turbine. In real-time, the blade size varies in millimeters due to various factors such as temperature, engine RPM, centrifugal force, etc. Therefore, monitoring this distance is crucial for the overall performance of the gas turbine. This study uses polynomial curve fitting to calculate the tip clearance of the gas turbine and display it in real-time. The primary focus of this study is to measure the tip clearance and display the real-time measurement along with the RPM, channel configuration, and pre-run check. The implementation is achieved with the help of LabVIEW, which is software designed for systems engineering. It is ideal for tasks that require control, measurement, and testing, and it provides fast access to data insights and hardware.

articleTitle: Healthcare Data Analysis using Competitive Ensemble Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: By utilising novel techniques to boost classification performance, ML is utilised to obtain healthcare knowledge. These classifiers have the potential to boost model decision and hence boost patient care. Recent research has shown that, compared to mixed model classification, the accuracy of single-model classification is worse. This study delves into the value of DL methods for both organised and unorganised healthcare databases. The exponential growth of healthcare data has made it challenging to mine for meaningful trends. Clinical data volumes are manageable for DL, and the results are improved. To enhance classification efficiency for structured data, a fresh competitive ensemble deep learning model has been presented. When it comes to Twitter sentiment analysis, however, the suggested work emphasises a competitive DL model that can handle unstructured data. The report also covers the planned Capsule Network for text data along with the Gravitational Search Algorithm (GSA). In order to assess the efficacy of the proposed model, it is compared to a more conventional model. The algorithm improved upon previous methods of analysing user sentiment on Twitter. The proposed model outperformed industry standards in the vast majority of tests. Furthermore, for multi-label classification problems, the outcomes are superior in terms of accuracy.

articleTitle: Smart Cabins of Tomorrow: An IOT Touch
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: In order to increase sustainability and general quality of life, this project examines the adoption of an intelligent cabin system powered by the Internet of Things. The technology uses the capability of IoT to create a productive and affordable environment where different cabin equipment can be easily managed and monitored remotely via a mobile application. The suggested approach gives users the ability to control appliances from anywhere via Wi-Fi, providing unmatched ease. The microcontroller serves as a focal point and makes it easier for hardware modules and the mobile app to communicate. This innovative method eliminates the need for complicated wiring, allowing for the seamless integration of a wide variety of equipment. The system optimizes data processing speed while minimizing data loss by utilizing wireless connection and relay-based controls. Users can follow appliance status with the use of the real-time monitoring feature, which helps create a more hospitable and sustainable living environment. This study underlines the value of user-friendly, energy-efficient technology in raising the standard of living overall while highlighting the potential of IoT in increasing smart living.

articleTitle: A Novel Hybrid GA-TLBO Algorithm for Minimization of Power Generation Cost
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Economic Load Dispatch (ELD) represents a challenging and nonlinear problem encountered in the power system's generation domain. This research introduces a new hybrid algorithm that merges the advantages of both Genetic Algorithms (GA) and TLBO algorithm. The hybrid approach introduces dynamic teaching factors and step size-based learning mechanisms, effectively addressing traditional TLBO limitations and mitigating the risk of getting trapped in local minima. The TLBO component enriches exploration within the search space, allowing for a broader examination of potential solutions, while the GA component enhances exploitation by fine-tuning the search within promising regions. Comprehensive testing of the proposed algorithm is conducted using the IEEE 30-bus system, comparing its performance against that of conventional TLBO algorithms as well as contemporary optimization techniques. The outcomes of this research reveal that the proposed algorithm surpasses its counterparts in terms of reliability, robustness, and accuracy. This innovative approach holds promise for optimizing economic load dispatch in power systems, offering a more efficient and dependable solution.

articleTitle: Utility Model for Visual Recognition using Enhanced Long-term Recurrent Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: A new model for video identification and explanation assignments. The model combines the benefits of long short-term memory (LSTM) networks for sequence modeling and convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for extracting features from images. The proposed model is assessed using a dataset of videos and outperforms the state-of-the-art models. The model is suitable for various applications such as video captioning, action recognition, and video retrieval. The suggested model comprises of two primary elements: a long short-term memory (LSTM) and a convolutional neural network (CNN). The CNN extracts feature from each video frame. The LSTM then uses these features to predict the next frame in the video. The model is trained on a datasetof videos that have been labelled with their corresponding actions. The model isevaluated on a test set of videos that have not been seen before. The model outperforms cutting-edge models on the test set. This study showcases the significance of recurrent convolutional structures for tasks related to visual identification and explanation.

articleTitle: Forecasting of Crop Yield using Agro IOT System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The Crop seeds Growth simulation Model plays an important role in Agricultural Meteorology. Various Computer models like Deterministic, Stochastic models replicate a scientific demonstration of a physical system. The aim of the proposed crop seed growth simulation model is to assess farming production based on weather conditions, surface soil, water and nutrients for crop management. To develop automatic advisory system to send crop management advisories to registered farmer’s information of the crop. This model gives detailed growth and development information along with yield estimation.

articleTitle: Blockchain in Higher Education: Key Research Themes and Future Directions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: This research paper explores the applications of blockchain technology in higher education, focusing on areas where it can bring transformative changes. The study addresses research gaps by conducting a comprehensive bibliometric analysis to understand the overall research landscape, specific applications, and challenges of blockchain in higher education. The findings provide insights into publication trends, influential contributors, and emerging research directions. The study highlights the potential of blockchain in areas such as credentials and certificates, record-keeping, micro-credentials, payments, research, and data management. This research contributes to advancing knowledge by guiding future research directions and facilitating the integration of blockchain technology in higher education systems.

articleTitle: Design of Microstrip Patch Antenna for WBAN Applications with Defective Ground Structure
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Antenna flexibility has a significant role for applications in wearable body area networks, and designing of flexible antennas faces many challenges. In this paper rubber substrate with a loss tangent of 0.02 and a dielectric constant of 3.1 is used for flexibility purpose with a defected ground structure (DGS) on an Inset-Fed Microstrip patch antenna (MPA). DGS enhances the antenna's performance as well. The antenna operates at the resonant frequency of 2.4 GHz for the ISM band having Return loss (S11) -18.89 dB and directivity of 7.14 dB with a bandwidth of 70 MHz. The VSWR is 1.98 at 2.4 GHz. The maximum gain realized at the resonant frequency is 4.69 dB with an efficiency of 56.85%. With the aid of the HFSS (High Frequency Structure Simulator), the antenna's design, performance analysis, and simulation were all carried out. The focus of this paper is an improvement in the gain and other parameters for WBAN applications.

articleTitle: Autonomous Search and Rescue Agent Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Disaster management is one of the areas of paramount importance for any government or organization. This process gets very tedious and tricky for some specific type of disasters. Deploying manpower for mitigating the disaster and saving the victims is a risky decision because the life of the people in the disaster management team is put to risk, which is a very unfortunate thing. So instead of using manpower, we can deploy intelligent machine agents, which are equivalent or sometimes more efficient than human beings for such highly risky tasks and avert the loss of lives. In our case, we have specifically considered the disaster wherein fire breaks out in a building and people get trapped inside due to the dangerous situation. In this case, where deploying manpower to rescue them requires a high quality protective gear and can even put their lives on risk, we have proposed to deploy intelligent machine agents that are trained to figure out the path on their own and find their way to the victims after which a rescue operation can be performed by safely escorting the victims to a nearby exit in the building. The agent in the proposed application has been evaluated by the metrics such as the time taken to reach the victims and come back to the exit, the total rewards gathered by the agent during its exploration in the environment and the number of correct decisions it made during its journey. The agent takes an average time of 145.6 seconds to complete its operation in the real-time environment. It gathered an average peak cumulative reward value of -0.2 in the real time environment. The agent on an average, records 67.3% chance of making a correct decision (that gets a positive reward) given a state vector.

articleTitle: Unique Raspberry Pi-based Honeypot
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Honeypots run services to lure attackers and prospective scans on Telnet, SSH, and HTTP. The system detects and sends email alerts for any unauthorized access or potential denial of service (DoS) attacks. This is normally performed by the Honeypot application service. The authors propose converting the Honeypot app to as daemon service or corn, which checks status & restarts if required. The authors designed and developed a unique Honeypot framework, named PIPOT using a Python socket program with low-cost Raspberry Pi for monitoring and alerting, instead of using expensive server systems in small organizations running few services with little or no security alerting systems.

articleTitle: Multi-Pedestrian Detection using Hybrid ML Algorithms for Autonomous Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Forecasting vulnerable road user behavior is a prerequisite for the real-world implementation of Autonomous Driving Systems (ADS). The purpose of a pedestrian crossing should be detected instantaneously, particularly while driving in towns. This paper aims to detect multiple pedestrians and other automobiles while driving specifically on Indian Roads in real-time. Recent research suggests that vision-based models utilizing deep neural networks are useful for this purpose. For this paper we aim to develop an end-to-end pedestrian intention detection architecture that works well both during the day and at night. The main approach for the project is based on bounding boxes for object identification. using various deep learning techniques like YOLOv3, Darknet-53 and YOLOv7.

articleTitle: Hybrid Approach for Accurate Vocal Anomaly Detection Using State-of-the-Art
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Accurate voice anomaly detection is achieved by the suggested method's combination of signal processing for feature extraction and improvement with deep learning. Preprocessing, feature extraction, and anomaly detection are the three pillars upon which this approach rests. The raw vocal signal is improved during preprocessing by denoising and filtering. From the preprocessed signal, the feature extraction stage derives Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCCs) and their derivatives. Finally, an ensemble of three algorithms, including Support Vector Machines (SVM), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) Networks, and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), is used in the anomaly identification stage to conduct an in-depth evaluation of the detection of voice anomalies. The suggested hybrid method is meant to be more flexible and efficient in practical settings.

articleTitle: Heart Rate Monitoring on Facial RGB Images using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The approach described in this study for calculating pulse rate is both inexpensive and precise. By choosing the right channel and using principal component analysis, the desired signal was obtained. The study presents a novel, non-contact heart rate monitoring method. Following the completion of the required adjustments, the suggested approach may prove to be quite useful for monitoring family members. It's a non-contact, affordable way that we can do using a basic webcam or even the camera on a phone. This study Paper reveals that the prototype, which was created using OpenCV and deep learning techniques, may be used to analyse a person's face in order to determine their heart rate using the datasets that were made accessible, according to our study paper.

articleTitle: A Graphical User Interface for ECG Features Extraction and Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The Electrocardiogram (ECG) signals play an essential role in the diagnosing of cardiac conditions. In this context, a novel Graphical User Interface (GUI) has been presented to streamline the ECG feature extraction and classification process. The GUI is a user-friendly platform that empowers researchers, medical practitioners, and enthusiasts to interact visually with ECG data. Users can identify and extract relevant features from ECG signals through intuitive visualizations and interactive tools. The interface's effectiveness is rooted in its ability to simplify the complexities of ECG analysis, making it accessible to individuals with varying levels of expertise. By integrating state-of-the-art feature extraction techniques and classification algorithms, the GUI contributes to the development of robust diagnostic tools. The GUI's potential impact spans from aiding medical professionals in swift and precise diagnoses to enabling researchers to efficiently process large datasets for insights into cardiac health. While the GUI's capabilities hold immense promise, its success relies on addressing challenges related to algorithm accuracy, data quality, and user training. Rigorous testing across diverse datasets is essential to ensure reliable performance and, in this work, different ECG parameters are extracted for diagnosing normal and abnormal signals.

articleTitle: Hearing Aiding System for Impaired
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Hearing loss can be a significant challenge for individuals, affecting communication and quality of life. This project aims to address this problem by creating a device that converts sound signals into vibrations that can be sensed by deaf individuals. It uses an electric motor to produce vibrations and converted sound signals into electrical signals using a microphone and amplifier. The electrical signals were used to drive the motor, which produced vibrations that could be felt by the user. The vibrations were transmitted through a surface that could be touched or held by the user. It evaluates the effectiveness of our device in converting sound signals into vibrations and found that it was able to convey sound information effectively. This also evaluates the usability and acceptability of the device among deaf individuals, who found it to be easy to use and effective in conveying sound information.
